revisions.note: Ledger re-validated: 54 tasks, 0 schema errors, 0 cycles, append-only revisions intact, per-task advisory locks intact, verdict vocabulary closed (nothing outside the 13 mission tokens is accepted, including in the renderer). WORK-QUEUE.md is no longer hand-maintained: the prose lives outside GENERATED markers and the three tables inside them are rewritten from the JSON store, so the human view cannot drift from the machine view - and if it does, `render --check` fails, which is now assertion 12 of INV-10 in the regression guard. The resumable remainder after this group is 45 open tasks; the dependency-ordered list is section 6 of WORK-QUEUE.md.
